failure_summary.description: The agent repeated a flight search instead of retrieving the compatible cached route-and-date results and filtering them.
The agent omitted the arrival-time constraint expressed as “arrive by” a specified time.

patch.reasoning: The existing skill already directs the agent to refine compatible cached results, so repeating that rule would be redundant. The uncovered gap is translating an upper-bound time phrase into the two-endpoint flight time range.

edits.content: - Interpret flight time requests using the two-endpoint `departure_time` and `arrival_time` ranges: an exact “at t” means `[t, t]`; “by t” or “no later than t” means `[12:00 AM, t]` for that day's range. Put the range in the field matching whether the user means departure or arrival, and do not omit an explicitly stated time bound.
